speaker: CSM Grant
text: Right, you lot, eyes front! Look left, look right, then double over to my flag.
say: Right, you lot, eyes front! Look left, look right, then double over to my flag.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Over the start line, sprint for the ditch, jump it, and over that wall. Move yourself!
say: Over the start line, sprint for the ditch, jump it, and over that wall. Move yourself!

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Wire! Get down on your belly and crawl under it. Then kneel behind the sandbags.
say: Wire! Get down on your belly and crawl under it. Then kneel behind the sandbags.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: No bridge for you, lad. Through the water, and out the far side.
say: No bridge for you, lad. Through the water, and out the far side.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: The range, lad. Sten from the hip, rifle through the sights. Reload, and change weapons. Make every round count.
say: The range, lad. Sten from the hip, rifle through the sights. Reload, and change weapons. Make every round count.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Grenades. Draw a Mills bomb and lob it into the pit. Into the pit, mind, not at your feet.
say: Grenades. Draw a Mills bomb and lob it into the pit. Into the pit, mind, not at your feet.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: The PIAT. Heavy, slow, and it stops a tank. Pick it up, aim high, and put a bomb into that hulk.
say: The Pee-at. Heavy, slow, and it stops a tank. Pick it up, aim high, and put a bomb into that hulk.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: You've caught one, lad. Only a drill, but let's see you put on a field dressing.
say: You've caught one, lad. Only a drill, but let's see you put on a field dressing.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Against the clock, lad. Over the line, drop the defenders, take the bridge, and send Ham and Jam on the wireless.
say: Against the clock, lad. Over the line, drop the defenders, take the bridge, and send Ham and Jam on the wireless.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Not bad for a first parade. Eyes front, you'll do. Now the assault course.
say: Not bad for a first parade. Eyes front, you'll do. Now the assault course.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Over the wall and still breathing. Smartish now, lad, the wire is next.
say: Over the wall and still breathing. Smartish now, lad, the wire is next.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Crawled like a proper soldier. Mud suits you, lad. On to the canal.
say: Crawled like a proper soldier. Mud suits you, lad. On to the canal.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Wet through, but you made it. Jerry won't be impressed, mind. On to the range.
say: Wet through, but you made it. Jerry won't be impressed, mind. On to the range.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Good shooting. Sten, rifle and a tidy reload. Now for the grenades.
say: Good shooting. Sten, rifle and a tidy reload. Now for the grenades.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: In the pit, and not at your feet. Well done, lad. Now the PIAT.
say: In the pit, and not at your feet. Well done, lad. Now the Pee-at.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: That hulk won't be going anywhere. Nicely done. Now, a field dressing for you.
say: That hulk won't be going anywhere. Nicely done. Now, a field dressing for you.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Patched up and fit for duty. Jerry won't know what hit him. On to the bridge, and double!
say: Patched up and fit for duty. Jerry won't know what hit him. On to the bridge, and double!

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Eyes front, lad! Look around, then double over to my flag. I haven't got all day.
say: Eyes front, lad! Look around, then double over to my flag. I haven't got all day.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Sprint, lad, sprint! Over the start line, jump the ditch, then up and over that wall.
say: Sprint, lad, sprint! Over the start line, jump the ditch, then up and over that wall.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Down on your belly, lad! Crawl under the wire, then kneel behind the sandbags.
say: Down on your belly, lad! Crawl under the wire, then kneel behind the sandbags.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: In you go. Swim across and climb out on the far bank. The water won't bite.
say: In you go. Swim across and climb out on the far bank. The water won't bite.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Sten from the hip, rifle through the sights, then reload and change weapons. Get on with it!
say: Sten from the hip, rifle through the sights, then reload and change weapons. Get on with it!

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Take out the Mills bomb and lob it into the pit. Not at your feet, lad!
say: Take out the Mills bomb and lob it into the pit. Not at your feet, lad!

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Pick up the PIAT, aim high and hit that tank. It won't shoot itself.
say: Pick up the Pee-at, aim high and hit that tank. It won't shoot itself.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: You're bleeding, lad. Put on your field dressing, and do it smartish.
say: You're bleeding, lad. Put on your field dressing, and do it smartish.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Clock's ticking! Drop the defenders, take the bridge, and send Ham and Jam on the wireless.
say: Clock's ticking! Drop the defenders, take the bridge, and send Ham and Jam on the wireless.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Recruit! Bootcamp at Countess Wear before you meet Jerry, or are you going straight in?
say: Recruit! Bootcamp at Countess Weer before you meet Jerry, or are you going straight in?

speaker: CSM Grant
text: Skipping that one, lad? Jerry won't skip you. On to the next.
say: Skipping that one, lad? Jerry won't skip you. On to the next.

speaker: CSM Grant
text: That's bootcamp done, lad. You'll do. Now go and show Jerry what you've learned. Dismissed!
say: That's bootcamp done, lad. You'll do. Now go and show Jerry what you've learned. Dismissed!
